name: Northcoders Group PLC
summary: Northcoders Group PLC, established in 2021 and based in Manchester, UK, offers a wide array of software coding education programs across the United Kingdom. The company serves a diverse client base, including private individuals, government organizations, and corporate entities. Its offerings span intensive bootcamp courses, government-backed apprenticeships, and tailor-made training solutions, all delivered through both traditional classroom settings and flexible online platforms.
